results.title: Fissures
results.overview: After her daughter moves away, Dalva begins hearing strange noises in the house where she has always lived. As she becomes aware of the cracks in a daily life that is slowly falling apart, something seems to be trying to emerge.

results.title: Spag
results.overview: As Quebec City reels from an unprecedented act of violence, the shooter’s final words make their way onto the public stage.

results.title: Motherland
results.overview: Patria I is a medium-length film by Juan Ibarlucía and Magela Crosignani that reimagines the form of the Baroque oratorio within the post-industrial landscape of Argentina in 2026. Drawing on a south american reinterpretation of the myth of Cain, and employing music, poetry, performance, and installation art, the work takes the audience on a powerful sonic and emotional journey that spans an extraordinary range of human experience—from extreme violence to compassion and tenderness.

results.title: Computer No. 03
results.overview: The disappearance of a USB drive with unknown contents prompts an investigation into its whereabouts.

results.title: Eraserhead Xiu Xiu
results.overview: Eraserhead Xiu Xiu is a new live concert with accompanying film & full-length album that uses field recordings, concert specific homemade instruments, organ, modular synths, vocals, flashlights, electrical interference, and elements of musique concrete to express the bizarre emotionality, conflicted sexuality, relentless darkness, and singularly unsettled moonscape of this most incredible of midnight masterpieces.

results.title: The Roses of Marrakesh
results.overview: Leila is the devoted housekeeper of Madame Isabelle, who lives in a luxurious estate in the Palmeraie of Marrakech. Leila maintains the careful order of this timeless bubble, where everyone plays their role to perfection. Between her and Yusef, the head gardener, a tacit, quiet, and restrained friendship has formed. When Leila’s sister arrives unexpectedly, revealing a heavy secret from their past, the tranquillity of this microcosm begins to crack.

results.title: Three Ghosts
results.overview: The show is scheduled to be performed at PARCO Theatre in October 2026!  (Performances also scheduled in Osaka, Fukuoka, Aichi, Okayama, and Miyazaki in November-December)

results.title: VIVO 76: Alive in ‘76
results.overview: This work explores the culture and influences that shaped the creation and performance of the songs on Vivo!, the third album by Pernambuco-born singer-songwriter Alceu Valença, released in 1976. Through this album, it paints a portrait of the birth of Pernambuco’s psychedelic scene, ranging from its visual art and fantastical characters to the initial forays toward Rio de Janeiro and mainstream success. It is a journey back to the 1970s, viewed through the lens of today and the eyes of tomorrow.

results.title: Charlie Shaw's Revenge
results.overview: A group of workers preparing for the re-opening of a remote adventure park on the brink of bankruptcy, find themselves stalked by a silent killer. Cut off from any form of rescue, the survivors must band together to fight for their lives.

results.title: Semicolon
results.overview: Two old friends reconnect after the unexpected death of their best friend.

results.title: Jeffrey Dollmer
results.overview: Dahmer finds a doll in 1991 and performs a ritual in an attempt to transfer his spirit into it but is captured before he can finish his evil plans. For decades, the doll remains locked away in police evidence — until it is finally discarded and finds its way back into the world. In the present day, the doll’s spirit is accidentally summoned and quickly latches onto a young model who bears a resemblance to its former owner. When the model travels to a remote photo shoot, the possessed doll follows, turning the isolated set into a killing ground as it begins stalking fellow competitors and co-workers.

results.title: The Night Driver
results.overview: Traveling salesman is desperate to return home after surviving a run-in with a psychotic killer, only to be stalked relentlessly by him across the country and framed for several murders along the way. Kirk plays Max, a struggling single Mom bartender with a dark past who has a brief encounter with the salesman which changes her life forever.

results.title: A Bitter Place
results.overview: Saka (31) was diagnosed with an undiagnosed illness after suffering a work accident while driving a truck carrying hazardous chemicals. Saka, who did not believe in non-materialistic beliefs, visited a cult that practiced mass healing rituals. During the ritual, a riot broke out among the impatient worshippers who wanted to be healed. The cult leader appeared to heal the followers' wounds to diffuse the chaos. The incident left Saka amazed and convinced of the miracle, strengthening his faith in the cult. When it was Saka's turn to be healed, his condition worsened, and the wounds on his body grew larger. His faith began to fade, and Saka wanted to expose the cult's fraud.

results.title: Last Chance Motel
results.overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

results.title: Land of Shadows
results.overview: Following a tragic event that shattered her life, renowned author Alice Chevalier struggles to find meaning in her existence. Searching for answers and a sign from destiny, she meets Thomas, a mysterious man who offers her an experience that defies the boundaries of reality. Driven by the hope of rebuilding herself, Alice embarks on a mystical journey, like an astronaut venturing into the far reaches of the unknown.

results.title: The Salacity
results.overview: A morally obsessive blackmailer appoints himself the judge of other people's intimate lives. Targeting those he believes are guilty of infidelity and deception, he uses manipulation and fear to pursue his own idea of justice. As paranoia and violence intensify, his campaign exposes the obsession and desire for control beneath his moral certainty.

results.title: O Ladrão do Pão
results.overview: A fiction from the series "Contos Tradicionais Portugueses," based on a poem by Alexandre O'Neil, telling the story of a fisherman tired of the sea, who departs to conquer a new life on land.

results.title: The Limitless Orchestra - From Zimmer to Strauss
results.original_title: The Limitless Orchestra - From Zimmer to Strauss

results.title: Lola
results.overview: Lola Bleakley celebrates the art and joy of surfing, just for the sake of it all.

results.title: The Girl Who Never Resigns
results.overview: For middle schooler Miyeon, the Jungang Baduk (Go) Club in her neighborhood is her only refuge. But when the owner Myungkyun receives a terminal diagnosis, the club faces closure, and Jiho, who works there part-time, proposes that Miyeon take an entrance test at another baduk academy.
